checks.message: Provisional rough status, source, precision, official_boundary=false, and non-statutory limits are disclosed; content review remains eligible.

Proposal, matrices, geometries, metrics, sources, assumptions, figures, HTML, and drawings form a cross-referenced evidence chain.
